description: This file defines custom formatters for specific SRS estimator configuration and result classes within a 5G NR signal processing context. It includes formatting logic for displaying configuration parameters and estimation results, including channel matrix normalization and resource allocation details.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::srs_estimator_configuration>
classes.description: Custom formatter for ocudu::srs_estimator_configuration, formats resource and slot info, including CRB and RE details.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::srs_estimator_result>
classes.description: Custom formatter for ocudu::srs_estimator_result, formats timing, power, RSRP, noise variance, and channel matrix norm.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options for the formatter.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the given configuration or result object into a string representation.
